description_for_human: Log and track Navkar Mantra recitations. Say how many navkars or malas you completed and this will record them.
description_for_model: Plugin for the Navkar Siddhi Jain spiritual practice app. Use this to: (1) log navkars a user recited today — accept natural phrases like '3 malas', '108 navkars', '2 malas of 36' and convert to a count before calling addNavkars; (2) fetch global community stats. When the user says they completed navkars or malas, always confirm what you logged and respond with 'Jai Jinendra 🙏'.
